items.title: Ernest "Punch" Miller Interview, 1957-multiple
items.q: they had a fellow named Wilbur Parrish, trombone, and a fellow named Brown, Henry Brown on piano.

ctx.x: Who else was in the band when you went up? Who else played in that band with you?
Well, they had a fellow named Wilbur Parrish, trombone, and a fellow named Brown, Henry Brown on piano. And, I'm trying to get back on it now, I can't.
Where'd they come from? They weren't from New Orleans then?

items.title: Ernest 'Punch' Miller Interview, 1959-09-25
items.q: I worked with him there... I played in theater with him

ctx.x: Yeah. Yeah, I worked with him there.
Let's get a little more on Wilbur Parrish, the drum hall player. When did you go with him?

He joined the Miriamak Miramaker show. To tell the truth, he come here with him when I joined him to New Orleans. He was with him. And I played in theater with him, see. And they asked me to come on and go away with him. And I just had gotten married too, but I explained it to my little wife, what to do when you're in the way. I told her after Lent I'd come right on back. But I went on and joined that show and went on up to Chicago and that was it, see.
